user_story: As a user, I want to delete a task so that I can remove items I no longer need.

positive.title: Successfully delete an existing task
steps: Navigate to the task list page.
Identify an existing task to be deleted.
Click on the delete option/icon/button associated with the chosen task.
Confirm the deletion action in the confirmation dialog, if prompted.
positive.expected_result: The selected task is removed from the task list and a success message is displayed.

negative.title: Attempt to delete a task with invalid permissions
steps: Navigate to the task list page as a user without delete permissions.
Identify any task from the list.
Attempt to click on the delete option/icon/button associated with the task.
negative.expected_result: The delete action is not executed. An error message is displayed indicating insufficient permissions.

edge.title: Attempt to delete a task that is already deleted
steps: Navigate to the task list page.
Identify a task and delete it.
Attempt to delete the same task again from the task list.
edge.expected_result: The system does not allow the second delete. An error message is displayed indicating that the task no longer exists.
